input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds the Issuer, Depositor or any of our entities anywhere in this Agreement, so the rule sits at the preferred position. Targeted searches for "compete", "exclusive", "solicit", "field of use", "engage in any business other than", "similar products or services" and "prohibited from" returned no restrictive covenant on us. The only "restriction" hits are generic no-conflict representations (p0240 Depositor, p0266 Servicer, p0279 Marketing Agent) confirming performance does not contravene third-party contractual restrictions — these create no covenant not to compete. p0346 limits the Servicer's obligation to license its servicing software to a Successor Servicer; that binds the counterparty's delivery obligations, not our freedom to operate, and is addressed under transition/IP rather than here. p0372 restricts the Depositor from transferring Depositor Transferred Property, which is a customary SPE transfer/assignment covenant protecting the securitization structure, not a field-of-use or competitive restriction. No redline proposed.
